email.subject1: a signal play for Higher Logic
email.body1:
Greg, saw Higher Logic Vanilla launched an MCP server wiring community data straight into AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude.

A launch like that usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can cover, and that is where good-fit deals quietly stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Higher Logic off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: a quick teardown of your outbound
email.body2:
Greg, quick follow-up for Higher Logic.

With your background spanning sales engineering and enablement, you know reps lose hours to research and CRM instead of conversations, and slow follow-up is where good demos go cold. Tightening that motion is often where the easy lift hides.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50 to 70 percent, and I will tailor it to your target accounts.
email.body3:
Greg, last bit of proof for Higher Logic.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Higher Logic's reply rate likely compares to other community and engagement software firms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Greg, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after an AI launch there is plenty competing for your attention.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your sales and enablement motion? I will tailor it to Higher Logic either way.
